title: Trainee - Civil Construction
abstract: Ready to kickstart your career in civil construction?
bullets: Free Certificate III in Civil Construction
Access to discounts and cashback at 600+ retailers and service providers
Access to a large catelogue of training opportunities
content_text:
The Package: $23.94 - $35.18 gross per hour + 12% super. (Evaluated as Trainee Grade 4 – 10 of the QPRC Salary System 2026) and Award increases of 4% in 2027-28 and 4% in 2028-2029. Full-time – 38 hours per week. 9-day fortnight conditions will apply.
Ready to kickstart your career in civil construction? Council is recruiting for a Trainee – Civil Construction to work alongside an experienced road construction and maintenance team whilst completing a free Certificate III in Civil Construction, paid by Council.
In this role you will:
- Receive structured on-the-job training in civil construction and assist in the construction and maintenance of Queanbeyan-Palerang’s extensive road network.
- Assist with the construction of roads, footpaths, kerb and guttering, undertake drainage and stormwater works, assist with excavation, trenching and earthworks, install signage and assist with traffic control.
- Learn how to safely operate plant required to construct and maintain Council’s roads such as graders, rollers, backhoes, bobcats and front end loaders, along with small plant equipment jack hammers, masonry saws, plate compactors, chainsaws, etc.
We are looking for someone who:
- Is eligible to be registered as a NSW Trainee and ability to satisfactorily complete a Certificate III in Civil Construction through an approved RTO.
- Has a strong interest in learning with capacity to work effectively in a team environment.
- Possesses good written and verbal communication and time management skills.
Working with us: The successful candidate will have the unique opportunity to work in a high-performing team whilst gaining a free qualification. Council staff also get access to a large catalogue of in-person and online training courses. The successful candidate can also take advantage of Council’s new reward and recognition program that allows our staff to access discounts and cashback at 600+ major retailers – learn more about these benefits here.
If you have any questions relating to the role, please contact:

- Coordinator, Transport Construction

Closing date: 9:00am Monday 26 October 2026
